limitations: Two heldout recordings with short stem-assisted visually reviewed passages. Provisional timing, not audited listening truth or native callback/display latency. Full-master mono, chronological causal processing. No tuning or parameter changes.
decision: Fails frozen heldout acceptance: persistence loses an originally associated Heavy On Mind kick. Neither reference nor persistence is reliable across these two recordings. Keep offline; no settings changed.
validation: 12 focused scorer/persistence tests pass. Both baseline sequences exactly replay in the diagnostic probe. Frozen labels and source hashes verified. No native callback, app or display test.
diagnosis_method: Read-only features from the same chronological masters. For each original missed label, inspect completed hops in [-15,+70] ms. All 31 misses have no simultaneous eligibility. In 30, each individual predicate passes somewhere in the window; one Heavy On Mind miss never exceeds body ratio 2. This locates a bottleneck, not proof that retaining independent predicates would solve classification. That broader change previously increased false fires. Persistence rejects the real 209.240 s kick because no consecutive body-ratio >2 pair occurs within the fixed validation bounds. No tuning performed.

heavy_on_mind_followup_audit.scope: Audit of fixed 200–212s core, not whole-song recall. Channels and isolated stem are diagnostic controls, not candidate changes.
